ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (black) pixels dominate over 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to distal tips and edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous solid low-intensity black region. Focal high-contrast white clusters are located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex; approximately 45-degree internal angle relative to the mid-line of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderately high-frequency serration along the distal third of both trailing edges; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature with a prominent upward sweep toward the tips; distal ends exhibit a sharp convex turn.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dense clusters of high-intensity white circular objects (barnacle-like) localized on the outer distal edges and tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable accumulation of white encrustations on the distal-most tips, creating a jagged, irregular profile on the fluke's outer boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast white circular spots on the extreme outer margin of the trailing edge, near the tips.
